title: Host Accounts Verification Deadline and Form 1099-K Thresholds
content:
# Tax and Compliance Memorandum — Host Accounts Thresholds

| Host tier | Identity verification must complete within | Taxpayer information required before payouts are released without withholding | Form 1099-K: gross payouts in the calendar year above | Form 1099-K: payout transactions in the calendar year above |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Host | 30 calendar days after opening | Yes | USD 20000.00 | 200 |
| Standard Host | 30 calendar days after opening | Yes | USD 20000.00 | 200 |
| Superhost | 30 calendar days after opening | Yes | USD 20000.00 | 200 |
| Professional Host | 30 calendar days after opening | Yes | USD 20000.00 | 200 |
| Professional Host Plus | 30 calendar days after opening | Yes | USD 20000.00 | 200 |
| Enterprise Partner | 30 calendar days after opening | Yes | USD 20000.00 | 200 |

## Notes on the Form 1099-K thresholds

The two Form 1099-K figures are "above" thresholds and both must be passed in the same calendar year. Hypothetical illustrations:

| Gross payouts in the year | Payout transactions in the year | Both thresholds passed? |
|---|---|---|
| USD 20000.01 | 201 | Yes |
| USD 20000.00 | 250 | No — the amount is not above USD 20000.00 |
| USD 35000.00 | 200 | No — the count is not above 200 |
